name: print-social-oriental-dumplings-menu-posts-charcoal-with-cloud-motifs
title: Oriental food menu pack on charcoal with orange and white titles, tilted photo cards and cloud motifs
whatItIs: Nine charcoal square posts, each naming a dish in orange and white condensed caps ('Oriental Dumplings', 'Ramen Seafood', 'Sushi Original'), with a tilted white-bordered food photo, small orange cloud and brushstroke motifs, and chopsticks line art.
whatItMeans: Appetising and consistent; tilted photo cards feel like snapshots pinned to a board.
techniques: Tilt food photos in white borders like prints.
Split dish names into two colours.
Add small cultural motifs like clouds as accents.
Keep one template and swap the dish.

vocabulary.definition: A photo with a white border like a print.
